headline: The league's two best quarterbacks this week both played from the bench. Both their managers won anyway, so nobody learns a thing.
dek: Waddle Deez Nutz benches its Waddle for a sixth straight week. Correctly, this time.

matchups.2-5: Amie lost by 15.7 to a team that didn't even play its top scorer. Maya's spare tire was C.J. Stroud, and he threw five touchdowns from the trunk.
matchups.4-6: Brock Purdy gave Tara three touchdowns, and she still lost the closest game of the week. Kyra's kicker, Cam Little, outscored every running back she started. At 8-1, she wins even when the kicker does the heavy lifting.
matchups.1-3: Marlee lost Josh Jacobs to a broken finger in the first quarter and won by 14.7 anyway. Maddie's Patriots D/ST (the team-defense slot) allowed 45 points to the Packers and finished below zero.
matchups.7-8: Samantha won the week's biggest blowout. Puka Nacua caught 14 passes for Cambri. Her running back, Derrick Henry, threw one. It lost three yards.

game_balls.title: Fresh off the wire
game_balls.text: Maya picked up Jonah Coleman and Ka'imi Fairbairn this week and started them right away. Coleman ran in a touchdown from the flex (the wild-card spot). Fairbairn kicked his way to 17. The new guys didn't even need orientation.

game_balls.title: The gut has a waitlist
game_balls.text: Kyra went with Joe Burrow over Matthew Stafford again. Burrow threw three touchdowns and ran in a fourth. Stafford watched from her bench. Start him instead and she loses.

game_balls.title: The receivers covered the spread
game_balls.text: Samantha's best quarterback was on her bench, so her receivers took over. Ja'Marr Chase and Christian Watson both topped 30 points. Watson needed only seven catches to get there. Spread covered.

flags.title: Kelce, benched again
flags.text: Cambri started Tucker Kraft at tight end. He caught one pass for one yard. Travis Kelce sat on her bench and ran in a touchdown. He outscored her starter from the bench in Week 2 too.

tough_breaks.title: Josh Jacobs, broken finger
tough_breaks.text: Josh Jacobs broke a finger in the first quarter and is having surgery this week, and reports say he could miss up to three weeks; here's to a quick recovery.

tough_breaks.title: Three 30-point games, one loss
tough_breaks.text: Three of Amie's players topped 30, including a Kenneth Walker III hat trick. It's the second time this season a huge week of hers ran into Maya's league high. Some rivalries are just the schedule's fault.

glossary.definition: The player who kicks field goals and extra points, scoring more for longer kicks; most weeks nobody notices him, but Cam Little scored 17 for Kyra, so consider him noticed.

How much the other team scores and gains against your D/ST (your whole team defense, counted as one player), and in this league giving up a lot of either costs you, as the Patriots D/ST found out for Maddie: 45 points and 478 yards allowed, −5 total.
Betting slang for winning by more than the experts expected, and Samantha's projected edge over Cambri was tiny before she won by 21.52.
Three touchdowns by one player in one game, like Kenneth Walker III's two receiving and one rushing for Amie this week.
